items.quote: Absolutely outstanding service! From the moment I called, the plumber was professional, prompt, and extremely knowledgeable. They quickly diagnosed the issue, explained everything clearly, and fixed it efficiently with no mess left behind. Pricing was fair and transparent, no surprises. It's hard to find reliable tradespeople these days, but this experience exceeded all expectations. Highly recommend to anyone in need of honest, high-quality plumbing work. Mr S is the one to call!!

We've had the pleasure of working with Mr. S Drain Cleaning & Plumbing Services on multiple occasions, and each time has been outstanding. He replaced our hot water heater and was meticulous in soldering the plumbing. We also had Devin plumb & install our remodeled kitchen sink faucets and water filter and again he was meticulous, and cleaned up completely after finishing the job. Pricing was fair and not over inflated like some companies like to do.

I recently had the pleasure of working with Mr S Drain Cleaning & Plumbing Services, and I can't recommend them highly enough. The team was punctual, courteous, and incredibly knowledgeable. They took the time to explain the issue, outline all my options, and provided a fair, transparent estimate before beginning any work. Not only did they fix the problem quickly, but they also left the workspace cleaner than they found it.

I contacted Mr S Drain Cleaning Plumbing Service to replace my garbage disposal. He arrived promptly. He started and completed the job efficiently. He checked every detail of the job to make sure everything was completed and working properly. He cleaned and left everything spotless. He also replaced my kitchen faucet.
